subject: Geografia
description_pt: Interpretar e elaborar mapas temáticos e históricos, inclusive utilizando tecnologias digitais, com informações demográficas e econômicas do Brasil (cartogramas), identificando padrões espaciais, regionalizações e analogias espaciais.

components.description_pt: Interpretar mapas temáticos contendo dados demográficos e econômicos sobre o Brasil
components.description_en: Interpret thematic maps containing demographic and economic data about Brazil
components.cc_component_description: Interpret graphical displays such as maps, charts, and tables to extract patterns from large data sets

components.description_pt: Identificar padrões espaciais e regionalizações representadas em cartogramas brasileiros
components.description_en: Identify spatial patterns and regionalizations represented in Brazilian cartograms
components.cc_component_description: Identify spatial relationships in data by analyzing patterns across geographic regions using maps or tables

components.description_pt: Construir mapas temáticos com dados demográficos ou econômicos sobre o Brasil, inclusive usando tecnologias digitais
components.description_en: Construct thematic maps with demographic or economic data about Brazil, including using digital technologies
components.cc_component_description: Identify spatial relationships in data by analyzing patterns across geographic regions using maps or tables

components.description_pt: Reconhecer analogias espaciais entre diferentes regiões do Brasil representadas em mapas temáticos
components.description_en: Recognize spatial analogies between different regions of Brazil as represented in thematic maps
components.cc_component_description: Identify spatial relationships in data by analyzing patterns across geographic regions using maps or tables

components.description_pt: Interpretar mapas históricos para analisar mudanças na configuração econômica ou demográfica do território brasileiro
components.description_en: Interpret historical maps to analyze changes in the economic or demographic configuration of Brazilian territory
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between resource distribution and patterns of human economic or social development

cc_matches.description: Use graphical displays (e.g., maps, charts, graphs, and/or tables) of large data sets to identify temporal and spatial relationships.
Resource availability has guided the development of human society.
